text:
oliver: Heads-up — seeing intermittent latency spikes on the fused QKV pack kernel when paged-KV is enabled. Microbench attached.

maya: repro steps?

oliver: run: ```bench_tool --kernel fused_pack --kv-mode paged --seq 1024 --batch 8 --profile perf --iters 200```

raj: numbers?

oliver: short seq (128): fused_pack = ~290us, flash_v2 = ~330us. long seq (1024): fused_pack = ~520us, flash_v2 = ~410us. pack helps short seq but regresses for long seq with paged-KV.

maya: hw + driver?

oliver: A100-80GB, driver 535, CUDA 12.1, runtime build d2026.

sasha: profile highlights?

oliver: perf counters: L2_MISS_RATE x3 vs flash_v2 for long runs, global_load throughput up ~2x, and kernel timeline shows epilogue memcpy overlapping repeated page faults.

raj: hypothesis?

maya: my guess — QKV packing + epilogue fusion rearranges memory layout such that paged-KV page locality is worse (hot tokens touch many pages), so we pay page-turn costs repeatedly. Epilogue fusion also pulls more data into L2 at once, evicting useful KV pages.

kevin: any quick mitigations?

sasha: try running epilogue out-of-line: ```--epilogue separate --prefetch on``` and/or increase prefetch window.

oliver: tried that: fused_pack + epilogue=separate drops long-seq to ~430us. Enabling prefetch window=32 further lowers to ~380us. So separating epilogue recovers most of the regression.

ci-bot: perf-ci: fused_pack+paged-kv long-seq median=520us (+27% vs flash_v2 baseline) — alert INF-2026-17 created.

maya: proposal: extend kernel-chooser policy to be KV-aware. Example rule: prefer packed-epilogue only if (seq <= 512 || kv_mode == none) and fallback to separate-epilogue when (seq > 512 && kv_mode == paged && est_pages_per_token > 1).

raj: also think batching heuristics need work: when paged-KV is active we should cap tokens_per_batch to avoid simultaneous page faults across many requests. Practical cap: tokens_per_batch <= 2048 for paged workloads (empirical).

kevin: add to that: tune prefetch aggressiveness based on expected page-turn rate; if chooser estimates >2 page-turns per token then enable aggressive prefetch and bias against packed kernels.

maya: tests to add: microbench matrix with seq in {128, 512, 1024, 2048}, kv in {none, paged}, kernels {flash_v2, fused_pack, fused_pack+separate_epilogue} and assert p90 regressions <10% vs best baseline per cell.

oliver: I'll prototype kernel-chooser change + prefetch tuning and run the nightly matrix. Will open a PR with numbers and a short doc for the rule.

kevin: thanks — if prototype looks good we should gate the change behind rollout flag + telemetry to measure regressions in prod.

oliver: noted. pinging @maya and @sasha for reviews when PR is up. :eyes:

ci-bot: reminder — add perf CI entries for the new microbench matrix (job: fused-attn-kv-matrix).
